units_and_basis.values: percentRate in PERCENT (2 decimal places), business-day aggregation of USD overnight money-market transactions; OFR percentiles p1/p25/p75/p99 also percent; NY Fed EFFR rows carry targetRateFrom/targetRateTo = 3.50/3.75 (FOMC target range, percent).
units_and_basis.volume: volumeInBillions = USD billions of daily transaction volume (e.g. SOFR ~2861 => ~$2.861T; EFFR ~91-114; BGCR ~1173-1210; TGCR ~1153-1181; OBFR ~189-252 in the samples).
units_and_basis.calendar: US business-day calendar (Mon-Fri minus US federal holidays). Weekend absence is calendar structure, not missingness. OFR range measured: SOFR 0.01..5.40, EFFR 0.04..5.33, BGCR 0.01..5.35, TGCR 0.01..5.35, OBFR 0.03..5.33.

gap_pattern_and_no_fill_boundary.pattern: Every mid-series absence in the OFR series is an ISOLATED SINGLE-WEEKDAY absence (longest gap = 1 business day) matching the US federal-holiday pattern (Jan 15 / Nov 15 / Dec 9 / Jul 9 per 8-9yr span; ZERO absences in August, which has no federal holiday). No multi-day mid-series gaps, no duplicate dates, no nulls, no non-numeric values. NY Fed 10-row samples show the same shape: weekends absent, single holiday absence 2026-09-07 (Labor Day).
gap_pattern_and_no_fill_boundary.boundary: NO-FORWARD-FILL: holiday/release-gap absences are never synthesized in either store. An as-of join must match on effectiveDate and treat an absent business day as ABSENT, never carried forward, unless the FOREX-NG7 plan explicitly allows a named fill rule. Retrieval-time-only stores NEVER get PIT gaps filled: there is no evidence when an earlier-missing value later appeared.

global_findings.identity_ruling: SOFR (secured overnight financing rate, broad Treasury repo), BGCR (broad general collateral rate), TGCR (tri-party general collateral rate), EFFR (effective federal funds rate), OBFR (overnight bank funding rate) are ALL USD money-market funding/reference rates. They are NEVER an FX signal and carry no FX identity. In FOREX-NG7 D2 they may be used ONLY as funding/liquidity regime controls (e.g., stress/regime gating, cost-of-carry context); any derived FX-swap-implied funding construct is out of scope of this dossier and would need its own identity audit.
